forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password
forgotPassword.body: Enter your username or email. If an account matches, we will send a reset link.
forgotPassword.successBody: If an account matches, a reset link is on its way. The link expires in 30 minutes.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.body: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.success: Password changed, sign in with your new password
resetPassword.invalidBody: The link is invalid, already used, or has expired. Request a new one.
